# D. Vaughn House

> D'Vaughn House is an Independent AI Orchestrator and AI consultant based in Cincinnati, Ohio. He helps small businesses, independent operators, and small teams adopt AI in practical, measurable ways — starting with one real workflow and a result you can measure, not a platform overhaul. His position: this shift is not another dot-com cycle, and people who engage with AI early will not be left behind.

D'Vaughn House also founded Glenride, an independent, AI-native think tank that researches supply-chain vulnerabilities, pharmaceutical data, and enterprise software systems — including a weekly digest of U.S. drug shortages built from public FDA and ASHP data.

## Canonical pages

- [Home](https://dvaughnhouse.com/): who D'Vaughn House is, what he offers, and how to start a conversation
- [About](https://dvaughnhouse.com/about): background — pharmaceutical project management and clinical research (University of Cincinnati; ICON Clinical Research contract assignments at AstraZeneca and Merck), voiceover production, and community work — and how engagements run
- [Support the work](https://dvaughnhouse.com/donate): voluntary support for the research and writing; Glenride is not a nonprofit and contributions are not tax-deductible
- [Become a patron](https://dvaughnhouse.com/patron): patron tiers for ongoing support of the research
- [Privacy](https://dvaughnhouse.com/privacy): how this site handles your information
- [Terms](https://dvaughnhouse.com/terms): terms for this site and its offers

## Offers and projects

- [Rapid Impact Accelerator](https://dvaughnhouse.store): a fixed-scope, fixed-price ($197) engagement that puts one AI workflow to work in your business
- [SpinWave / STANZA](https://spinwave.tech): a Glenride project on knowledge licensing — "Set knowledge free — then prove it"
- [The Den — Reynard's](https://den.dvaughnhouse.com): D'Vaughn House's storefront for field guides and goods
